GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #4 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. You meet your teacher at eight o'clock in the morning. Which greeting fits best? (1 mark)
   A. Tschüss
   B. Guten Morgen
   C. Gute Nacht
   D. Guten Abend

2. What does "Wie geht's?" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. How are you?
   B. thank you
   C. sorry, excuse me
   D. good day (daytime greeting)

3. What does "die Familie" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. grandfather
   B. father
   C. brothers and sisters
   D. family

4. What does "der Bruder" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. sister
   B. brother
   C. aunt
   D. mother

5. What does "der Herd" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. sofa
   B. fridge
   C. bed
   D. cooker

6. What does "die Lampe" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. garden
   B. kitchen
   C. house
   D. lamp

7. What does "der Tag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. day
   B. Monday
   C. Tuesday
   D. Saturday

8. Which day comes right after Montag? (1 mark)
   A. Samstag
   B. Mittwoch
   C. Donnerstag
   D. Dienstag

9. What does "der Luftballon" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. balloon
   B. party
   C. birthday
   D. present

10. What number is "neun"? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 12
   C. 13
   D. 9

11. What does "das Fleisch" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. meat
   B. tomato
   C. orange
   D. carrot

12. Which sentence means "I like eating bananas"? (1 mark)
   A. Ich esse gern Bananen.
   B. Ich trinke gern Bananen.
   C. Ich esse keine Bananen.
   D. Ich koche Bananen.

13. What does "der Reis" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cabbage or kale
   B. apple
   C. rice
   D. sugar

14. What does "Was isst du gern?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. What do you like to eat?
   B. Who eats?
   C. Where do you eat?
   D. When do you eat?

15. What does "der Kopf" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. ear
   B. toe
   C. head
   D. arm

16. What does "der Zeh" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. face
   B. hand
   C. foot
   D. toe

17. What does "das Gewitter" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. thunderstorm
   B. rain
   C. rainbow
   D. sky

18. What does "der Regen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. rain
   B. cloud
   C. snow
   D. wind

19. What does "sehen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to see
   B. to smell
   C. to sleep
   D. to hear

20. Which room do you link with "Ich dusche"? (1 mark)
   A. das Wohnzimmer
   B. der Garten
   C. die Küche
   D. das Badezimmer

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. A child arrives at school in the morning. Write in German what the child says to the teacher, and how the teacher asks how the child is, and the child's answer. (4 marks)

22. Explain how to pronounce ß, sch and z, with one example each. (3 marks)

23. Write the German words with their articles for: kitchen, bedroom, garden, living room. (4 marks)

24. Give two reasons why fruit and vegetables are good for the body. (2 marks)

25. Write the German greetings for "good morning" and "good evening". (2 marks)

26. Write in German: "Today is Wednesday. Tomorrow is Thursday." (2 marks)

27. Write in German: "The sun is shining." (2 marks)

28. Write the seven days of the week in German in order, starting with Monday. (4 marks)

29. Write the German words with der or die for: father, mother, brother, sister. (4 marks)

30. Read: "Heute ist Samstag. Vater liest im Wohnzimmer. Mutter kocht in der Küche." Give the gist. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #4 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Guten Morgen
   Morgen means morning, so Guten Morgen is the greeting for the morning.

2. A — How are you?
   Wie geht's? means How are you?.

3. D — family
   die Familie means family.

4. B — brother
   der Bruder means brother.

5. D — cooker
   der Herd means cooker.

6. D — lamp
   die Lampe means lamp.

7. A — day
   der Tag means day.

8. D — Dienstag
   After Montag comes Dienstag.

9. A — balloon
   der Luftballon means balloon.

10. D — 9
   neun is the number 9.

11. A — meat
   das Fleisch means meat.

12. A — Ich esse gern Bananen.
   gern shows you like doing it.

13. C — rice
   der Reis means rice.

14. A — What do you like to eat?
   was = what, isst = eat, gern = with pleasure.

15. C — head
   der Kopf means head.

16. D — toe
   der Zeh means toe.

17. A — thunderstorm
   das Gewitter means thunderstorm.

18. A — rain
   der Regen means rain.

19. A — to see
   sehen means to see.

20. D — das Badezimmer
   A shower is in the bathroom.

SECTION B
----
21. (4 marks)
   Answer: Guten Morgen! Wie geht's? Gut, danke.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Guten Morgen, 1 mark for Wie geht's?, 1 mark for Gut, danke, 1 mark for capital letters and punctuation.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: ß is a strong ss (Fuß). sch is sh (Schulter). z is ts (Zahn).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

23. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Küche, das Schlafzimmer, der Garten, das Wohnzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: They give vitamins and energy; they help us to stay healthy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: Guten Morgen and Guten Abend.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each greeting spelled correctly.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: Heute ist Mittwoch. Morgen ist Donnerstag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: Die Sonne scheint.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Die Sonne and 1 mark for scheint.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: Montag, Dienstag, Mittwoch, Donnerstag, Freitag, Samstag, Sonntag.
   Working / marking points: 4 marks for all seven correct; lose 1 mark for every two errors.

29. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Vater, die Mutter, der Bruder, die Schwester.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each noun with the correct article.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is Saturday. Father is reading in the living room and Mother is cooking in the kitchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the three facts.
